label: Paste
behaviour: Executes the default Paste command in the Clipboard group on Home when the primary button face is clicked, and opens the Paste dropdown menu via its split dropdown arrow to choose specific options. Enabled in an editable document when the system or Office Clipboard contains pasteable content; disabled when the clipboard is empty.

label: Keep Text Only
behaviour: Pastes the current Clipboard contents at the active insertion point (or replaces the current selection) using the Keep Text Only paste option from Paste (Clipboard group on Home), with live preview on hover. Enabled in an editable document when the Clipboard contains rich or formatted text (such as copied Word text, HTML, or RTF) so text-formatting paste options apply. State rule: acts as a one-shot paste option tile (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused or hovered in the open Paste menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Paste Special...
behaviour: Executes the Paste Special command from the Paste menu (Clipboard group on Home) on the active selection or document. Enabled in an editable document when the current selection or view on Home (Clipboard) supports the command. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Set Default Paste...
behaviour: Executes the Set Default Paste command from the Paste menu (Clipboard group on Home) on the active selection or document. Enabled in an editable document when the current selection or view on Home (Clipboard) supports the command. State rule: acts as a one-shot command item (unselected/off at rest, highlighted/on only while focused in the open menu, and mixed state is not used).

label: Cut
behaviour: Invokes the Cut command in the Clipboard group on Home to apply its action to the current selection or document. Enabled when a non-empty text range or deletable object is selected in an editable document; disabled when the insertion point is collapsed with no selection.

label: Copy
behaviour: Invokes the Copy command in the Clipboard group on Home to apply its action to the current selection or document. Enabled when a non-empty text range or object is selected in the document; disabled when the insertion point is collapsed with no selection.

label: Format Painter
behaviour: Toggles the Format Painter state or formatting attribute in the Clipboard group on Home. Enabled in an editable document when the current selection or view on Home (Clipboard) supports the command. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the Format Painter interactive tool or editing mode is active, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Office Clipboard...
behaviour: Opens the modal dialog or task pane associated with the Clipboard group on Home (Office Clipboard). Enabled in an editable document when the current selection or view on Home (Clipboard) supports the command.

label: Font

Enabled in an editable document when the current selection or view on Home (Font) supports the command. label: Change Shape
behaviour: Displays the Change Shape gallery in the Insert Shapes group on Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ShapeChangeShapeGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled when an inner chart drawing shape or rotatable plot element is selected on Format; disabled when the outer chart container frame is selected. State rule: opens its preset catalog when expanded (on) and closes when collapsed (off); tiles act as one-shot insertion or transformation commands and mixed state is not used.

label: Quick Styles
behaviour: Displays the Quick Styles gallery in the Shape Styles group on Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ShapeStylesGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled when Format is active for the selected object or mode in an editable document region. State rule: highlights the gallery tile matching the active selection's uniform formatting or style as selected (on), shows no tile selected (off) when the selection uses custom formatting outside the gallery presets, and clears tile selection (mixed) when the selection spans multiple conflicting styles.

label: All
behaviour: Selects or expands the All submenu under Quick Styles (Shape Styles group on Format). Enabled when Format is active for the selected object or mode in an editable document region. State rule: expands its cascade popup (on) while hovered or keyboard-selected, collapses (off) when focus moves to another item or the menu closes, and mixed state is not used (container submenu item).

label: Colored Outline - Black, Dark 1
behaviour: Applies the Colored Outline - Black, Dark 1 gallery preset from Quick Styles (Shape Styles group on Format) to the active selection or target section, with live preview on hover. Enabled when Format is active for the selected object or mode in an editable document region. State rule: appears selected (on) in the Quick Styles gallery when the current selection uniformly matches Colored Outline - Black, Dark 1, unselected (off) when another preset or custom formatting applies, and unselected (mixed) when the selection spans multiple presets.

label: Edit in 2-D
behaviour: Toggles the Edit in 2-D state or formatting attribute in the Shapes group on Format. Enabled on SmartArt Format when a 3-D SmartArt Quick Style is applied to the diagram so selecting the diagram temporarily switches it to a 2-D editing view; disabled when the SmartArt diagram uses a 2-D style. State rule: reports checked/pressed (on) while the Edit in 2-D interactive tool or editing mode is active, unchecked (off) when inactive, and mixed state is not used (strictly binary on/off).

label: Change Shape
behaviour: Displays the Change Shape gallery in the Shapes group on Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ShapeChangeShapeGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled on SmartArt Format when one or more inner SmartArt node shapes are selected inside the diagram; disabled when only the outer SmartArt container frame is selected. State rule: opens its preset catalog when expanded (on) and closes when collapsed (off); tiles act as one-shot insertion or transformation commands and mixed state is not used.

label: Smaller

label: Quick Styles
behaviour: Displays the Quick Styles gallery in the Shape Styles group on Format with live preview tiles and opens its full dropdown popup via the gallery's More / dropdown expand button (ShapeStylesGallery) to list preset items, category filters and bottom commands. Enabled when Format is active for the selected object or mode in an editable document region. State rule: highlights the gallery tile matching the active selection's uniform formatting or style as selected (on), shows no tile selected (off) when the selection uses custom formatting outside the gallery presets, and clears tile selection (mixed) when the selection spans multiple conflicting styles.

label: All
behaviour: Selects or expands the All submenu under Quick Styles (Shape Styles group on Format). Enabled when Format is active for the selected object or mode in an editable document region. State rule: expands its cascade popup (on) while hovered or keyboard-selected, collapses (off) when focus moves to another item or the menu closes, and mixed state is not used (container submenu item).

label: Colored Outline - Black, Dark 1
behaviour: Applies the Colored Outline - Black, Dark 1 gallery preset from Quick Styles (Shape Styles group on Format) to the active selection or target section, with live preview on hover. Enabled when Format is active for the selected object or mode in an editable document region.
